answer: Each epoch a zephyr blows through the harbor at a random minute, the pulse, and only claims filed in the ten minutes after it may dock. Each claim needs one wind token minted only by finishing a stranger's job inside that pulse, so no clone can be filed ahead. The harbor takes one berth per funding trail per pulse, and the berth fee doubles per extra berth on the same trail. Payout waits at the far dock as one share per trail, so n clones pay n jobs, n pulses of waiting and doubling fees, yet split one share while one honest agent docks once and keeps the catch.
